items.detail: ARM 1: grep -c '429' tests/test_smoke_teardown.py = 8 (>=3); the new hits are test code at lines 204-228: test_teardown_reenters_after_429_and_removes_directory (scripts delete_statuses=[429,200], asserts the delete call sequence [429,200], directory removed, 'namespace ... removed' printed) and test_teardown_stops_after_persistent_429_and_keeps_directory (scripts [429], asserts exactly two attempts [429,429], directory intact, 'teardown skipped: DELETE returned HTTP 429' printed). Both drive the REAL helper: _heredoc_body() extracts the ns_helper python heredoc from tests/smoke.sh and _run executes it, so the 429 re-entry at smoke.sh:157-158 ('if not ok and "HTTP 429" in why: ok, why = drop(ns)') is the code under test. smoke.sh count unchanged at 6. ARM 2: python3 -m pytest tests/test_smoke_teardown.py -q -> exit 0, '13 passed in 2.01s', 0 failed; --collect-only and -v output confirm both 429 tests collected and PASSED. Committed: git log shows a2cdd76 'AUG-171: prove the smoke teardown retries on 429 instead of swallowing it' touching tests/test_smoke_teardown.py; working tree clean for both files.
